phen.effect: an enzyme breaks down sugar outside a living cell

home-blood-glucose-meter.flag: Own job 'measures' as for Clinical thermometer (it reads a level; Rapid test strip, a yes/no test, is 'diagnoses'). The enzyme pad on the strip (glucose oxidase) has no card; its effect sits on the meter, worded as on the Continuous glucose monitor. A 'Glucose oxidase' part would have 2 uses (this, CGM), not 3. Rapid test strip isn't a slot: it's an antibody strip, not this enzyme strip. Battery not in its text, left off.

slots.note: The Canada GIS ran on an IBM mainframe; Computer is the board's general computer card, as for Email and the ATM.

phen.effect: map layers pinned to the same coordinates are laid over one another

geographic-information-system.flag: Own job 'computes' (it answers questions of maps); 'stores data' would also do. Geometry is maths the practice carries out (rule 22: overlaying layers by coordinates); uncertain, drop if it reads as too general. Map scanner and plotters left off (not in its text).

phen.effect: solid shapes built from flat triangles are projected onto a flat picture

computer-generated-imagery.flag: Graphics processor (1999) did this job later; the 1982 films were rendered on mainframes and minicomputers (Computer card, as elsewhere). Motion pictures as the film it is shown in, like the TV in Video game console; persistence of vision stays with it. Lighting left off: the computer simulates how light bounces (Optics) rather than working by it (rule 5); only the geometry is maths it carries out (rule 22). Uncertain whether Boris wants either effect.

slots.note: Same key technique as the Internet.

phen.effect: each machine waits a random instant, so a second clash is unlikely

local-area-network-ethernet.flag: Packet switching is the Internet's key-technique gap; with this and Mobile broadband (3G) sending data 'in packets' that's 3 uses, so it earns a card. Probability is the Randomized controlled trial's gap (maths the job carries out, rule 22); now 2 uses. The computers and printers it links are what it's used on (rule 8), not parts. Switch is a later addition, left off.

desktop-publishing.flag: PostScript (letters drawn from outlines) is the key technique; no card, and its only job would be 'stores data', so left off. Letters scaled from outlines could link to Geometry (maths it carries out, rule 22) but is left off as loose; add it if wanted. Page-layout program (PageMaker) has no card.

rolling-suitcase.flag: Own job 'transports' as for Wheelbarrow. Telescoping handle and the case have no cards and aren't shared; left off. Tipping the weight over the axle is the wheelbarrow's balance, which has no effect on the board either (rule 28).

slots.note: A radio mirror, as in the Radio telescope.
It amplifies the signal and lowers its frequency, the superheterodyne's trick.

phen.effect: a curved mirror focuses light

direct-to-home-satellite-tv.flag: Follows the Radio telescope's dish, receiver and effect. The satellite hanging over one spot is its orbit, which sits with Communications satellites (rule 23). Own job 'communicates' like Commercial comsats; 'shows the image' would also fit.

slots.note: The comb fingers are a capacitor; Leyden jar is the board's capacitor card.

phen.effect: a weight on springs lags behind when its case speeds up or tilts

mems-motion-sensors.flag: Accelerometer isn't a slot (rule 6: the same thing made small, like Transistor radio and Radio), so its own effect, inertia, sits here; drop if Boris reads it as a general law (rule 28). The spring's elasticity is a material property (rule 28), left off. Stored charge sits with the Leyden jar (rule 23); the capacitor stand-in is uncertain (rule 9).

phen.effect: the reader's changing magnetic field drives a current in the card's coil

contactless-card.flag: Coil filled by Insulated wire (a wound copper coil); the slot job is weak, since the coil picks up power and signals; no 'coil' or 'antenna for near fields' card. Induction is the key effect, on the card because the coil's card states only conduction. Plastic body left off (no card).

phen.effect: a signal splits into separate frequencies

home-broadband-dsl-and-cable-modem.flag: Fourier analysis worded as Wi-Fi's: the modem chip splits the line into hundreds of bands (rule 22). 'As much data as its noise allows' is Shannon's channel limit; no card, not shared, left off. Internet isn't a slot: it's what the line connects to.

phen.effect: a drug jams an enzyme so a body process slows

kinase-inhibitor-cancer-drugs.flag: Enzyme inhibition now has 4 uses among new cards (Statins, Antiretroviral HIV therapy, this, ACE inhibitors; Anti-rejection drugs in the parallel batch also shuts down an enzyme), so it earns a phenomenon card. Wording kept identical (rule 12). Imatinib itself has no card. Chemotherapy ('kills the germ but not the patient') left off: it's about germs, and the specific effect is the enzyme block.

phen.effect: current heats a wire
the wick draws the liquid up to the coil

electronic-cigarette.flag: Own job 'sprays' (it makes a mist, like Spray cans); uncertain, no 'delivers a drug' job. Heating coil, wick and the liquid's ingredients (propylene glycol, glycerine, nicotine) have no cards and aren't shared; so Joule heating and capillary action sit on the whole, as capillary action does on the Oil lamp. Flash-boiling and droplets forming as the vapour cools left off as general (rule 28).

online-maps-and-navigation.flag: Phone: Google Maps reached ordinary phones in late 2005; Smartphone (2007) shown as later. Servers filled by Microchips as for Search engine (Cloud data centres is 2006). Route planning is a shortest-path algorithm, maths with no card and not shared (Ride-hailing uses this card instead); left off. Satellite photos are how the maps are made (rule 4). Trilateration sits with GPS (rule 23).

slots.note: Organic LEDs; the board's LED card is the crystal kind, the only LED card.

phen.effect: three colours of light mix to make any colour

oled-display-2000s.flag: LED as a stand-in for the organic film (rule 9); the alternative is a key-part gap 'Organic LED'. Glowing sits with the LED card (rule 23). Colour mixing worded as Color television. Glass vs bendable plastic varies by model; drop the glass slot if too minor.

slots.note: Docomo's 1999 set used its own codes; Unicode took emoji in 2010.

emoji.flag: Unicode is the board's card for characters stored as agreed numbers, which is how the card says emoji work; but the 1999 Japanese emoji used carriers' own codes, so Unicode only fits from 2010. Drop it if that matters. The phone's font has no card. No nameable effect.

slots.part: tracking radar and the interceptor's seeker

rocket-interceptor-system.flag: Own job 'protects' (it defends towns); 'fires projectiles' would also fit the launcher. NEW SHARED GAP 'High explosive' (TNT/RDX): the warhead here, FPV attack drone's charge, Precision-guided bombs' filling and the Cruise missile's warhead all lack a card (Dynamite, Nitroglycerine and Cordite are older and different). Interceptor's solid rocket motor left off: no solid-rocket card (Liquid-fuel rockets would be wrong). Predicting where a rocket lands is gravity on a projectile (rule 28 lesson: no gravity for a missile's arc). Signal delay sits with Radar.

software-containers.flag: A practice made of another practice (rule 3): Docker walls containers off with Linux's own features. Servers it runs on are what it's used on (rule 8), so Cloud data centres isn't a slot. No nameable effect.

phen.effect: blood soaks up green light, so less comes back with each surge
each heartbeat swells the arteries

smartwatch-and-fitness-tracker.flag: Own job follows Pulse oximeter. Haemoglobin colour is the pulse oximeter's gap; now 2 uses (not 3). Blood circulation worded as the pulse oximeter (rule 25). Inertia sits with the motion-sensor chip (rule 23). Six slots; the screen (OLED on the Apple Watch, not named in its text) or the chip could go to keep it tight. Battery not in its text.

phen.effect: faces are compared by how close they lie as points in a space of numbers

facial-recognition.flag: NEW JOB 'identifies people': Facial recognition, Biometric digital ID, and DNA fingerprinting (parallel batch); otherwise 'detects objects' or 'protects' is nearest. Geometry (distance between points) is maths the job carries out (rule 22); uncertain, drop if loose. Learning from photos is how the network is made (rule 4). The 3D dot projector (iPhone X) is in the date note only.

slots.note: Lown's 1962 capacitor design; Beck's 1947 machine shocked straight from the mains through a transformer.

phen.effect: muscles work by electrical impulses

defibrillator.flag: Effect worded as Pacemaker and Electrocardiogram (rule 12); the specific use is one shock making every fibre contract at once. The heart's own rhythm-setter (sinoatrial node) has no card; with Pacemaker it would be 2 uses. Capacitor is newer than the card's 1947 date; if that matters, replace with changes voltage: Transformer (Beck's set-up). Pads/paddles left off (no card).

phen.effect: a drug jams an enzyme so a body process slows
a hormone squeezes the blood vessels narrow

ace-inhibitors.flag: Enzyme inhibition: the shared gap (see Kinase inhibitors). Hormones is the body process it works with (rule 25), as for Beta blockers. The snake-venom peptide is what the drug was modelled on (rule 5, borrowed), not a part. Captopril has no card.

phen.effect: hormones regulate the body

recombinant-protein-drugs.flag: Own job follows Oxytocin synthesis and Steroid synthesis (insulin is a hormone); 'treats illness' would also do for the wider class. No slots: the human insulin has no card, and the bacteria, gene splicing (Recombinant DNA, Genetic engineering) and fermentation tanks are how it's made (rule 4), as are their effects. Effect worded as Oxytocin synthesis (rule 12).

slots.note: Electric Pencil ran on the Altair-type kit computers of 1975-76.

word-processor-software.flag: Own job 'writes' as for Typewriters. Personal computer (1977) is a year newer, so Microchips fills the slot with it as 'later' (rule 14); if Boris prefers the plain Spreadsheet pattern, use Personal computer alone and drop keyboard and screen. Printer left off: no card fits 1976 (Laser printers 1982). Character codes are binary numbers, which sit with Microchips.

active-matrix-lcd.flag: LCD is a slot by rule 7 (the whole earlier screen is inside, refined, like Microscope in Ultramicroscope); read it as rule 6 instead and the slots become Polaroid, Glass and Transistor with the liquid-crystal effect here. Liquid crystals and polarization sit with LCD and Polaroid (rule 23). Holding the voltage between refreshes is the transistor's switching, no separate effect.

phen.effect: the body learns to fight a germ
a sugar bolted onto a protein brings in the immune system's helper cells

conjugate-vaccines.flag: Helper T cells is the key effect with no card (rule 16 exception). The bacterial sugar coat and the carrier protein (a tetanus or diphtheria toxoid) have no cards; Antitoxin is a different thing. How the two are bolted together is how it's made (rule 4).

fly-by-wire-airliner.flag: Uses the new Accelerometer card (the A320's are in its inertial units, not MEMS chips). Rudder stands for all the control surfaces, as fins did in Precision-guided bombs (rule 9). Airplane isn't a slot (rule 6), and wing and engines are left off since its text is about the controls. Side-stick has no card. No own-level effect: stalling is what it prevents, not what it works by.

open-source-operating-system.flag: Own job 'computes' (it runs the computer). The servers and phones it runs on are what it's used on (rule 8). Distributed version control (2005) came later and isn't in its text. Review by maintainers is a technique with no card. No nameable effect.

secure-web-connection-ssl-tls.flag: Own job 'protects' as for Public-key encryption. Prime factorization sits with Public-key encryption (rule 23). Certificates and the fast secret-key cipher have no cards; World Wide Web is what it's used on (rule 8).

slots.part: two data and two power wires

universal-serial-port-usb.flag: Own job 'communicates' (a data link between devices); 'carries current' would fit the power half. Asking the device what it is (enumeration) is a technique with no card. Twisted pairs rejecting noise left off as general. No nameable effect.

electronic-voting-machine.flag: Own job 'computes' (it counts votes, like the Adding machine); 'measures' would also do. Tally printer left off (no card). Five slots; encryption could go if too minor.

online-encyclopedia-wiki.flag: Follows Social media's slots. Own job 'communicates'; 'writes' (as for Large language models) or 'stores data' would also do. The wiki itself (Cunningham, 1995) has no card. No nameable effect.

phen.effect: a fingerprint calculated from the contents changes if anything in them changes

distributed-version-control.flag: Own job 'stores data' (it keeps the code's whole history). Cryptographic hash is maths the job carries out (rule 22), the key effect with no card (like Prime factorization for Public-key encryption); uncertain whether Boris counts it. Line-by-line merging is a technique with no card.

phen.effect: the body learns to fight a germ

rotavirus-vaccine.flag: Follows the Sabin vaccine (also live, weakened and swallowed): no slots, one effect. Growing the virus until it is weak is how it's made (rule 4).

off-grid-solar-lighting.flag: No own-level effect: the photoelectric effect, the battery's reaction and the LED's glow all sit with their parts (rule 23).

phen.effect: no two people have the same fingerprints or irises

biometric-digital-id.flag: New job 'identifies people' (see Facial recognition). Fingerprint scanner and Unique fingerprints are its key part and key effect with no card (rule 16 exception); the effect might be shared by Facial recognition (faces) and DNA fingerprinting (repeat counts), if Boris wants one 'Every person is different' card. Facial recognition (2017) isn't a slot: newer, and Aadhaar's face matching came later. Central computers filled by Microchips as for Search engine.

ride-hailing-apps.flag: GPS sits inside Smartphone, so not listed again. Cars filled by First automobile as the board's car card; drop if the practice is read as only the matching service. Matching and surge pricing are techniques with no card. No nameable effect.

slots.note: A stent on a wire, pulled back out instead of left in.

stroke-clot-retrieval.flag: Coronary stent is a close stand-in for the stent retriever (rule 9); 'holds the contents' is the nearest job for catching the clot. X-ray imaging follows Cardiac catheterization; X-rays passing through tissue unevenly sits with Cardiac catheter (rule 23). The mesh springing open is a material property (nitinol, rule 28).

grid-battery-storage.flag: NEW SHARED GAP 'Inverter' (turns direct current into alternating): this, Solar farm (parallel batch) and the HVDC converter stations (now filled by Electronic rectifier) would share it; otherwise fill with Transistor. The grid's frequency sagging when supply falls short is what it responds to, not what it works by; left off. The battery's reaction sits with Lithium-ion battery (rule 23).

fpv-attack-drone.flag: Quadcopter drone is a slot by rule 7 (the whole earlier machine is inside); its camera, motors and gyroscopes aren't repeated. Own job 'explodes' as for Cruise missile and Precision-guided bombs. High explosive: shared gap (see Rocket interceptor system). LCD stands for the goggles' screens (often LCD or OLED). No own-level effect.
